description: This Java class 'SerialPortReader' facilitates asynchronous reading from a serial port, either through polling with progressive sleep or event-driven mechanisms. It manages data reception, threading, and event listening for serial port communications.

classes.name: SerialPortReader
classes.description: Handles asynchronous reading from a serial port using polling or event-driven mechanisms, and forwards incoming data to a DataListener.

methods.name: SerialPortReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serial port reading thread, which continuously reads incoming data and forwards it to the provided DataListener.

methods.name: progressiveSleepRead
methods.description: Attempts to read data from the serial port with increasing sleep durations between attempts, returning the data if available.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Handles serial port events; logs unexpected events or states, especially for Windows 10 compatibility issues.

methods.name: readInitial
methods.description: Reads any data in the serial port buffer at startup and passes it to the DataListener.

methods.name: getSerialPortEventListener
methods.description: Returns the event listener for serial port events.
